passages.title: A School Reading Drive — Visual and Verified Notes
passages.text: Visual description: The illustration shows two students placing books into boxes on a library table. A sign says “BOOK DONATIONS.” There is a shelf behind them. Verified event note: The school library held a reading drive on Friday, 16 October. Students sorted donated books for the school reading corner. The note does not identify the students by name or say how they felt.

passages.title: A School Garden — Visual and Verified Notes
passages.text: Visual description: Three students are watering young plants in the school garden. A small sign says “GARDEN CLUB.” Verified note: The club planted 24 seedlings on Tuesday. The picture does not show whether the plants will survive or whether the club has won a prize. The school invites volunteers to help with watering next week.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of an informative photo caption?
choices: To explain relevant information about the image
To hide what appears in the picture
To make every image sound like an advertisement
questions.explanation: Caption informatif menjelaskan isi atau konteks visual secara relevan; tidak perlu menciptakan cerita dramatis.

questions.prompt: Which caption best matches a drawing of two students arranging books?
choices: The school has won an international prize.
All students love to read every day.
Two students arrange books on a library table.
The students will become professional writers.
questions.explanation: Pilihan C menjelaskan tindakan yang terlihat. Informasi penghargaan, perasaan semua siswa, dan masa depan tidak didukung gambar.

translationId.prompt: Caption mana paling sesuai untuk gambar dua siswa menata buku?
choices: Semua siswa suka membaca setiap hari.
Dua siswa menata buku di meja perpustakaan.
Para siswa akan menjadi penulis profesional.

questions.prompt: Which detail should never be guessed from a picture alone?
choices: The exact date of the event
questions.explanation: Tanggal tepat biasanya memerlukan catatan kegiatan yang valid; meja, kotak, dan buku dapat dilihat langsung jika tampak jelas.

translationId.prompt: Rincian mana yang tidak boleh ditebak hanya dari gambar?

questions.prompt: Which caption is an invitation rather than a description?
choices: The students stand beside a bookshelf.
The library has two large windows.
Students are placing books in boxes.
Bring a gently used book to our reading corner.
questions.explanation: [[Bring]] meminta pembaca melakukan tindakan, sehingga menjadi caption ajakan.

translationId.prompt: Caption mana merupakan ajakan, bukan deskripsi?
choices: Para siswa berdiri di samping rak buku.
Para siswa memasukkan buku ke kotak.
Bawalah buku bekas layak pakai untuk pojok baca kami.

questions.prompt: According to the first note, where are the students placing books?
questions.explanation: Catatan visual secara eksplisit menyatakan [[on a library table]]. Jangan menambah lokasi yang tidak ada.

translationId.prompt: Menurut catatan pertama, di mana siswa menaruh buku?

questions.prompt: Which information is verified in the first event note?
choices: The reading drive took place on Friday, 16 October.
The students are all Grade 12 learners.
questions.explanation: Tanggal Jumat 16 Oktober disebut di catatan kegiatan yang telah diverifikasi. Perasaan, hadiah, dan kelas siswa tidak disebut.

translationId.prompt: Informasi mana yang diverifikasi dalam catatan kegiatan pertama?

questions.prompt: Which opening gives the clearest factual caption for the first visual?
choices: The best people in the world
questions.explanation: Subjek dan tindakan yang didukung visual dan catatan membantu pembaca memahami peristiwa.

translationId.prompt: Pembuka caption mana paling jelas dan faktual untuk visual pertama?

questions.prompt: What is the safest statement about the two students in the first passage?
choices: They are unhappy with their school.
Their names and feelings are not given.
questions.explanation: Catatan secara jelas tidak menyebut identitas maupun perasaan para siswa. Kesimpulan lain tidak beralasan.

translationId.prompt: Pernyataan mana paling aman mengenai dua siswa pada bacaan pertama?
choices: Nama dan perasaan mereka tidak diberikan.

questions.evidence: does not identify the students by name or say how they felt

questions.prompt: What does “24” refer to in the second note?
questions.explanation: [[24 seedlings]] berarti dua puluh empat bibit yang ditanam klub. Tidak berkaitan dengan pengunjung atau penghargaan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang dimaksud angka “24” pada catatan kedua?

questions.prompt: Which claim is NOT supported by the second passage?
choices: The event note says the club planted seedlings.
The school invites volunteers to help next week.
questions.explanation: Bacaan menegaskan bahwa gambar tidak menunjukkan apakah tanaman akan bertahan hidup; klaim semua bibit pasti hidup terlalu kuat.

translationId.prompt: Klaim mana TIDAK didukung bacaan kedua?
choices: Sekolah mengajak relawan membantu minggu depan.

questions.evidence: does not show whether the plants will survive

questions.prompt: Which detail could be used to identify the activity in the second visual?
questions.explanation: Tulisan [[GARDEN CLUB]] adalah detail yang tersedia dalam deskripsi visual dan relevan untuk mengidentifikasi kegiatan.

translationId.prompt: Rincian mana dapat mengidentifikasi kegiatan dalam gambar kedua?

questions.prompt: Which caption type adds a visible action to the identification of a subject?
choices: A document title with no image
questions.explanation: Dalam pengelompokan yang sering diajarkan, [[cutline]] menyebut siapa/apa dan apa yang dilakukannya; jenis identifikasi terutama menyebut subjek.

translationId.prompt: Jenis caption mana menambahkan tindakan yang terlihat setelah mengidentifikasi subjek?
